title: Resolve intermittent egress namespace ghosting causing tenant DNS misbinding after Dedicated pool scale-down
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Several customers on Dedicated reported transient DNS responses resolving to incorrect tenant endpoints after autoscaler scale-downs. Investigation showed a race between egress namespace recycling and conntrack/iptables teardown where short-lived flows could be rebound to a different tenant's SNAT mapping for ~500-2000ms. This ticket captures the production fix, short-term mitigation, and rollout plan.
comments: 2025-02-05 - Aisha Patel: Pager triggered by CUST-9482, CUST-9510. Initial triage: symptoms are cross-tenant DNS resolution immediately after GPU pool scale-down events. Customer impact: intermittent but reproducible under controlled scale-down testing.

2025-02-06 - Marco Ruiz: Repro on staging by repeatedly scaling down a 6-node pool to 2 nodes while driving DNS-heavy egress traffic. Packet captures show DNS UDP replies returning to an IP that was just reassigned to a different tenant's ephemeral SNAT port range.

2025-02-07 - Eng rotation: Root cause hypothesis: egress namespace IDs (egress_ns) are reused by the node agent on worker restart/scale-down. There is a teardown ordering issue where conntrack entries and NAT chains are not fully flushed before the egress namespace index is reassigned, leading to transient mapping collisions.

2025-02-08 - Marco Ruiz: Short-term mitigation applied to staging: drain hook to quiesce egress flows and force conntrack purge on the node before egress_ns reassignment. Observed elimination of DNS misbinds in test runs. Prepared quick rollback-free rollout as feature flag in node-agent.
2025-02-10 - Security review: Security team confirmed mitigation reduces attack surface but requested additional audit logging for SNAT allocation events. Added logging task to follow-up.

2025-02-11 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-agent/pull/1423 - adds pre-scale-down conntrack purge, monotonic egress_ns allocator, and extra debug logging for SNAT allocations. Tested on staging and canary cluster 3. Monitoring dashboards show DNS misbind rate dropped to zero during canary window.

2025-02-12 - Customer comms: Notified impacted customers (CUST-9482, CUST-9510) about mitigation and planned full rollout during low-traffic maintenance window 2025-02-14 03:00 UTC. Support provided workaround (temporarily disable aggressive autoscaling) while rollout is scheduled.

2025-02-12 - QA: Integration tests added to runtime-integration to simulate scale-down + high DNS QPS and assert no cross-tenant responses for 120s post-scale event. Tests run in CI and included in pre-merge checks.
2025-02-12 - Ops: Runbook updated (link below) with detection query and rollback steps. Added alert: "EgressNS:TransientDNSMisbinds" that fires if cross-tenant DNS metric > 0 for 5m.
resolution_plan: 1) Merge node-agent PR with feature-flagged conntrack purge and monotonic egress_ns allocator.
2) Canary rollout to 5% of Dedicated nodes for 24h with high-DNS traffic smoke tests.
3) Expand canary to 25% for additional 24h, validate Grafana metrics and customer telemetry.
4) Full rollout during maintenance window with post-deployment verification and extended monitoring for 72h.
5) Postmortem and follow-ups: add stronger unit/integration tests, increase telemetry granularity, and implement SNAT allocation audit logs per security request.
